Since the `make_virtual` transform was not applied, I will write the test without a seam. I will use Moq to mock the `ILogger` interface.

Let's submit the test file.

<tool>submit_test(csharp)</tool>
```csharp
using Xunit;
using Moq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Orleans.Transactions.TestKit;

namespace Orleans.Transactions.TestKit.Base.Tests
{
    public class RemoteCommitServiceTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task Pass_LogsInformation()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<RemoteCommitService>>();
            var service = new RemoteCommitService(loggerMock.Object);
            var transactionId = Guid.NewGuid();
            var data = "test data";

            // Act
            await service.Pass(transactionId, data);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogInformation("Transaction {TransactionId} Passed with data: {Data}", transactionId, data), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task Fail_LogsInformation()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<RemoteCommitService>>();
            var service = new RemoteCommitService(loggerMock.Object);
            var transactionId = Guid.NewGuid();
            var data = "test data";

            // Act
            await service.Fail(transactionId, data);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogInformation("Transaction {TransactionId} Failed with data: {Data}", transactionId, data), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task Throw_LogsInformation()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<RemoteCommitService>>();
            var service = new RemoteCommitService(loggerMock.Object);
            var transactionId = Guid.NewGuid();
            var data = "test data";

            // Act and Assert
            await Assert.ThrowsAsync<ApplicationException>(() => service.Throw(transactionId, data));
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogInformation("Transaction {TransactionId} Threw with data: {Data}", transactionId, data), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
```

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace Microsoft.Extensions.Logging
{
    public static class LoggerExtensions
    {
        public static void LogInformation(this ILogger logger, string message)
        {
            logger.Log(LogLevel.Information, default(EventId), message, null, null);
        }

        public static void LogInformation(this ILogger logger, EventId eventId, string message)
        {
            logger.Log(LogLevel.Information, eventId, message, null, null);
        }

        public static void LogInformation(this ILogger logger, string message, params object[] args)
        {
            logger.Log(LogLevel.Information, default(EventId), message, args, null);
        }

        public static void LogInformation(this ILogger logger, EventId eventId, string message, params object[] args)
        {
            logger.Log(LogLevel.Information, eventId, message, args, null);
        }
    }
}
